I have three half siblings, and my Mom and step dad have been divorced for 9 years. The custody issue has been going on throughout my whole teenage life and has really caused stress and damage on the family that will honestly never be reversed. My sister(17) lives with her Dad because he has money and gave her a car if she would live with him. My other brother(15) doesn't want anything to do with his Dad and his father gave him up because of other events that happened between them. Now about my little brother(13). His Dad and step Mom give him no rules, all the things he wants, and let him do whatever he wants. He has been put under pressure to live with them and always comes home from his Dads and is absolutely horrible to us, screaming he hates us and just being an asshole about everything to make us miserable.

My 15 year old brother (lets call him Adam) is extremely into hockey, and has been recruited to play for a high profile team up in Michigan. The only reason my Mom hasn't moved up there so he can play is because of my little brother and she's been trying to find a family for Adam to live with but is having no luck. This is a HUGE oppurtunity for Adam to get into college or even into the NHL. So last night Mom broke down and said she didn't know what else to do but give up custody of my little brother so that Adam can have a chance. She is an absolute wreck because she loves him so much, but his behavior and his unwillingness to change, plus constant screaming at her for not letting him live with his father, has helped her decide that this is the only way to go.

I feel absolutely awful for my Mom, I hate seeing her cry and be in such pain, but the awful truth is I do not like my little brother at all. I love him, but hate the person he's become and turning out to be. Adam really does have potential to make something out of his hockey skills, and I think it is the right decision. I feel closed off and unhappy when he's home, and when he leaves I get this sense of pure relief and I feel so much happier. This was great to get off my chest.
My Mom has to give up custody of my little brother, and I honestly couldn't be happier about it
